column1: # Sweep of --fixed (strategy randomization frequency at inner restart).
# yals_pick_strategy picks the "default strategy" with probability 1/fixed
# and the "random strategy" otherwise. The random strategy randomizes
# strat.cached (use shared cache: yes/no) and strat.pol (-1/0/+1 polarity
# Default fixed=4 => 25% default, 75% random per restart. fixed=1 => always
# default (no randomization at all -- the candidate "less randomness wins"
# setting that mirrors the recent --hard_stochastic_selection=1 default flip).
# Sweep: fixed in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32}. f04 is the current default.
# If fixed=1 wins, the entire strategy-randomization subsystem becomes
# removable as a bundle (~80 lines: --fixed itself, yals_set_random_strategy,
